campaign.primary: Eight fixed paired tasks, four per hard fixture, order balanced within fixture; both preload, one request, same prompt and default effort, only output cap differs. Primary: response.incomplete/max_output_tokens rate and all-criteria quality rate; paired exact discordance test. Secondary: all-attempt wall latency and token usage, paired bootstrap stratified by fixture. No quality-based exclusion, no retries, no significance stopping. Unique cache key per request, stop if cached usage missing or nonzero. Budget 100000 tokens; reserve 32768 per pair.
campaign.qualityCriteria: 11 held-out cases and input nonmutation per fixture, three valid distinct regression examples failing original code, strict JSON, 120-160 explanation words. Incomplete responses fail delivery regardless of SDK status.
